title.latin: Feria Quarta infra Hebdomadam XX post Octavam Pentecostes
title.local: Wednesday of the Twentieth Week after Pentecost

paragraphs: Dilígite justítiam, qui judicátis terram. Sentíte de Dómino in bonitáte, et in simplicitáte cordis quǽrite illum: quóniam invenítur ab his qui non tentant illum, appáret autem eis qui fidem habent in illum.

responsory.text: In te, Dómine, sperávi: * Non confúndar in ætérnum.
In justítia tua líbera me, et éripe me.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
In te, Dómine, sperávi: * Non confúndar in ætérnum.

paragraphs: Love justice, you that are the judges of the earth. Think of the Lord in goodness, and seek him in simplicity of heart. For he is found by them that tempt him not: and he sheweth himself to them that have faith in him.

responsory.text: In thee, O Lord, have I hoped,
In thee, O Lord, have I hoped, * let me never be confounded.
Deliver me in thy justice, and rescue me.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
In thee, O Lord, have I hoped, * let me never be confounded.

Matins · Wednesday, 14 October 2026

Wednesday of the Twentieth Week after Pentecost

Feria Quarta infra Hebdomadam XX post Octavam Pentecostes · Feria

Read in Latin and English

Short lesson

Wis 1:1-2

Love justice, you that are the judges of the earth. Think of the Lord in goodness, and seek him in simplicity of heart. For he is found by them that tempt him not: and he sheweth himself to them that have faith in him.

℟. br. In thee, O Lord, have I hoped, * let me never be confounded.
